tasks.answer: Use flight-delay.FlightDelayEventCreateScreen from @/features/flight-delay-compensation/event-create-screen as the create-delay-event page. It requires no props and builds a flight delay event from flight, catalog and price-preview form fields; it needs router, query and i18n context and persists a local draft before submit. Compose its form sections with ui.UiCard from @/components/ui/layout (no required props; pass children, optional title/extra; onClick makes it interactive). If the intent is instead viewing an existing event, the sibling page is flight-delay.FlightDelayEventDetailScreen, which requires eventId.
